race.comment: PERFECT NIGHT (12) is no world beater but finds a nice scenario here. She was a beaten favourite two back at Ballarat and again last time at Geelong but is racing well and gets a lovely run just behind the pace. Craig Williams replaces the apprentice and should give her every hope, notably with blinkers going on. THERE WERE ROSES (10) resumes. She won her maiden over this track and trip fresh last time in and will be hitting the line. SEABORN (7) resumes having shown staying promise last campaign, this is a good kickoff point. SURPERB FROST (4) should be ready to peak from a good draw and is in the mix.
